subject: Transition Canvas + Weekly Ops Cadence for Lumencorp MAP
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Transition Canvas + Weekly Ops Cadence for Lumencorp MAP

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed weekly ops cadence to guide the onramp and handoff to CS/Implementation. The goal here is to align milestones, owners, and dates so we have a single source of truth for the 90-day launch timeline.

Key points in the attachment (Lumencorp_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone slate with acceptance criteria (API keys, test data, readiness sign-off)
- Owner assignments (Redwood vs Lumencorp) per task
- Week-by-week runway through go-live + post-go-live stabilization

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You and Jason to confirm IT security pre-check (expected by 4/8)
2) Lumencorp to provide sample data extract (by 4/11)
3) Redwood to provision staging tenant and share endpoints (by 4/12)
4) First technical alignment call (pre-integration kick) — propose 4/13 10:00am PT

I’ve copied Ben (Implementation lead) and Marcus (Solutions architect) so they can pick up task owners. If this looks good, we’ll finalize the MAP and push an updated SOW for redlines.

Quick ask: please reply with any date conflicts or missing owners so we can lock the calendar before Monday.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Lumencorp_MAP_v1.xlsx, Lumencorp_SOW_draft_v1.pdf

Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -07:00

Priya —

Appreciate the clear doc and timeline. Quick confirmations from our side:
- IT security pre-check: Jason will complete the checklist by 4/8 (we’ll attach a short status note).
- Sample data: we can deliver a truncated extract by 4/11 (sensitive fields redacted).
- 4/13 at 10:00am PT works for the tech alignment call for Jason and me.

A couple of questions / clarifications:
1) On the MAP milestone "Staging Validation", is the acceptance criteria a signed test plan or a successful smoke test run?
2) Who is the primary contact for incident routing during the initial 14-day stabilization window?

Also, I opened the MAP in Drive and left a few inline comments (see link). We will review the draft SOW once you share the redline-enabled PDF.

Thanks,
Samantha

Director of Platform Integrations | Lumencorp
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transition Canvas + Weekly Ops Cadence for Lumencorp MAP

Thanks Samantha — helpful questions. Answers below and I’ve updated the MAP attachment to make both explicit.

1) "Staging Validation" acceptance criteria: both — a signed test plan (shared template in the MAP) AND a successful predefined smoke test run in the staging tenant. We require sign-off from Lumencorp QA (Jason) and Redwood Implementation (Ben).
2) Incident routing during the 14-day stabilization: primary contact will be Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai). Ben will run the on-call bridge for the first 14 days; after that we transition to standard CS on-call rotation. Escalation tier 2 is Marcus Lin (solutions) and tier 3 is me.

I added a small "Decision Log" sheet in the MAP to capture any agreed deviations (helps later for acceptance). Also uploaded SOW draft (redline-enabled PDF) to the Drive folder — link below.

Proposed weekly ops cadence (summary):
- Weekly ops call: Tuesdays 9:00am PT — 30m standing (status, blockers, tickets)
- Technical sync: Thursdays 10:00am PT — 60m (deep dive implementation tasks)
- Go/no-go checkpoint: two checkpoints — Pre-cutover (1 week out) and Day0 (start-of-day)

Links:
- MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xLumencorpOnboarding
- SOW draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B_SOW_Lumencorp_draft

Ben / Marcus — can you confirm you’re able to own the incident routing and attend the proposed weekly cadence?

Best,
Priya
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lowe <samantha@lumencorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transition Canvas + Weekly Ops Cadence for Lumencorp MAP

Priya / Samantha —

Confirmed: I’ll be primary on-call for the 14-day stabilization and will join the weekly ops calls and technical syncs. Marcus and I will split the integration tasks as follows (also reflected on the MAP sheet):
- Redwood provisioning & staging endpoints: Marcus Lin (deliver by 4/12)
- Staging smoke test plan & automation: Ben Carter (deliver test plan by 4/14, execute 4/15)
- Data ingestion validation: Lumencorp provides sample by 4/11 -> I will validate and share results by 4/13

Escalation path noted. I’ll prepare a short runbook for the Day0 bridge and share it in the Drive folder by EOD 4/5.

Attachment references: I uploaded a runbook stub: "Day0_Bridge_Runbook_v0.1.md" to the folder.

See you on the 4/13 tech call.

Ben
